items.factual_review: The Brontë Parsonage Museum distinguishes Charlotte's Jane Eyre from Emily's Wuthering Heights. Oxford's English faculty confirms 1847 publication under Currer Bell and describes Jane's retrospective, crafted narration. The British Library catalogue identifies Charlotte's fair-copy manuscript, its submission to Smith, Elder and Co., and the historical title Jane Eyre: An Autobiography, Edited by Currer Bell. The article does not infer literal author autobiography or claim a disputed day of first publication.
